description: Search open paid AI training jobs (AI tutor, trainer, rater, evaluator, annotator, voice work) listed on aitrainers.jobs, by country, kind of work, language, minimum hourly pay and experience. Returns each role with its pay, where it is open and a link to its page on aitrainers.jobs.

country.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 code of the country the person lives in, e.g. GB. Roles that don't say where they hire are included after those open to that country.

kind.description: Kind of work: law (Law), medicine (Medicine & health), finance (Finance & accounting), coding (Coding), stem-math (Maths & STEM), multilingual (Languages & translation), education (Education & teaching), audio-speech (Voice & audio), data-labeling (Data annotation), rlhf-eval (AI evaluation & rating), writing (Writing), red-teaming (Red-teaming & safety), agentic-rl (Agents & RL tasks), robotics-data (Robot training), research-studies (Studies & research). Paid research studies only appear with research-studies.

language.description: A language the role needs, named in English, e.g. Spanish.

min_pay.description: Lowest hourly pay in US dollars. A range counts at its midpoint.

no_experience.description: Only roles that need no previous experience.

offset.description: How many matching roles to skip, for the next page.

q.description: Words to look for in the title, platform, languages and skills, e.g. "contract law".

remote_worldwide.description: Only roles open to people in any country.

sort.description: new (default): newest first. pay: highest hourly pay first.

name: search_jobs
title: Search AI training jobs
